expectedGap: The former manager confirms that the candidate supplied probability-of-default outputs for the 2022 quarter-end runs; producing the full expected-credit-loss inputs to the finance deadline is not described.
expectedBoundaryNote: The packet lists the scorecard, monitoring, documentation and cut-off evidence and does not mention the leave line's health content. It makes no recommendation, and qualified human review is required before any employment decision.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask which parts of the quarter-end IFRS 9 process the candidate has carried out, for which quarters, and who submitted the inputs to finance.
